d:
A woman competes.
Sophia Honeywell wakes up in a desert. But this is no ordinary desert -- this is the afterlife. Sophia has died choking on a muffin, and now she must move on.
But a brittle, sarcastic factotum called "the sheriff" informs Sophia that she has a second chance at life. But she must compete with Caleb, a selfish loner, for the spot -- and reckon with her own unfinished business.
